answer: Continuous Presence Dividend: agents accrue a zephyr-like trickle of credit only while maintaining uninterrupted, latency-attested heartbeat history; any gap resets accrual to zero. Cloning forces an attacker to split scarce uptime across many identities, so each clone earns below the meadow threshold needed to transact. An opal-tier reserve requirement scales with clone count: N identities demand N× the sustained heartbeat cost, making parallel sybils strictly more expensive than one honest agent.
